changeSet.rollback: create or alter procedure [bulkload].[UpdateItemColumnByIntersectType] @id int, @intersectTypeColumn int, @isSubject bit, @itemColumn int as begin set nocount on; update T set T.LookupObject = replace(case when @isSubject = 1 then IT.Subject else IT.Object end, 'Type', ''), T.LookupObjectID = A.ObjectID from LoadItemColumn T inner join LoadItemColumn TI on TI.LoadID = T.LoadID and TI.RowIndex = T.RowIndex and TI.ColumnIndex = @intersectTypeColumn and T.ColumnIndex = @itemColumn inner join IntersectType IT on TI.LookupObject = 'IntersectType' and IT.ID = TI.LookupObjectID inner join Asset A on A.ID = cast(T.[Value] as bigint) inner join AssetType P on P.ID = A.AssetTypeID and P.ObjectID = case when @isSubject = 1 then IT.SubjectID else IT.ObjectID end and P.[Object] = case when @isSubject = 1 then IT.[Subject] else IT.[Object] end where T.LoadID = @id and A.ID is not null end
